justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/mutable/MutableFloat.java and compared it with src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/mutable/MutableDouble.java and src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/mutable/MutableInt.java. MutableFloat is a single-state wrapper with one field (`value`) and a cohesive set of 31 public methods on the same concern: constructors, add/subtract/increment/decrement, getters/setters, Number conversions, equality/hashCode, and `isNaN`/`isInfinite`. The 416-line file is similar in structure and size to the sibling mutable numeric wrappers, with no clear split into separate responsibilities or low-cohesion clusters, so insufficient modularization is not evidenced.
